jobs.title: Senior IT Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced and driven Senior IT Engineer to serve as a senior technical contributor on Posit's IT Operations team, supporting our distributed workforce, corporate systems, and enterprise AI infrastructure.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and driven Senior IT Engineer to serve as a senior technical contributor on Posit's IT Operations team, supporting our distributed workforce, corporate systems, and enterprise AI infrastructure. The ideal candidate is a seasoned systems administrator and support engineer who has moved beyond day-to-day ticket response and is ready to take ownership of critical platforms, lead cross-team technical efforts, and mentor more junior team members. You'll play a leading role in operating our IT infrastructure, raising the bar on our processes and documentation, and ensuring the productivity and security of our employees. IT Operations owns and runs the platforms everything else rides on — identity, endpoints, SaaS systems, the enterprise AI platform, and the infrastructure for our enterprise automation platform. Our department's mission is to empower Posit's employees with reliable technology, maintain a robust IT environment, and operate the platform foundation for the company's enterprise AI program. You will collaborate closely with other teams across the organization to achieve our departmental mission. We achieve this through proactive system management, responsive user support, code-driven operations, and continuous process improvement, enabling innovation with effective IT solutions. Since its inception, Posit has operated as a 100% distributed company with a SaaS-first infrastructure, complemented by select platforms we host and manage ourselves in AWS. This presents unique challenges and requires pragmatism, creativity, and a collaborative, detail-oriented approach to be successful.

You will own:

  • End-to-end ownership of one or more core IT platforms (platforms such as Okta, Google Workspace, Jamf Pro, Zoom, Slack, or the infrastructure for automation platforms such as n8n, Workato, or Okta Workflows) — including configuration, health, security posture, and roadmap. For the automation platform, that means the platform itself — hosting, upgrades, access, backups, and monitoring — while IT Engineering builds the workflows within it. While most of our stack is SaaS, some platforms are self-hosted in AWS, and that infrastructure is ours to run.
  • Complex technical escalations across end user devices (Mac, Windows, Linux) and SaaS applications, serving as the senior point of contact when issues exceed the scope of Tier 1 support.
  • Design and implementation of meaningful improvements to employee technology workflows — onboarding, offboarding, device lifecycle, access provisioning with scalability at the forefront.
  • Day-to-day operational ownership of Posit's enterprise AI platform and its supporting integrations, including SSO/SCIM health, license management, desktop deployment via MDM, and front-line support for complex issues.
  • Technical mentorship of IT Engineers — pairing on tickets, reviewing pull requests, and leveling up the team's technical practices.
  • Maintenance of SaaS configurations, end user device controls, system access controls, and patch management according to approved guidelines, with a high bar for security and compliance.
  • Creation and upkeep of technical documentation, runbooks, and playbooks for the systems and processes you own.
  • Leading scheduled audits of IT-controlled systems and coordinating remediation of findings.
  • Driving IT's GitOps practice forward — managing meaningful portions of your owned systems through version-controlled code, pull requests, and peer review, and coaching others through the same workflow.

You will assist with:

  • Defining and refining IT's engineering standards, including IaC patterns, code review expectations, and exception processes.
  • Contributing to procurement, vendor evaluation, and technical assessments for new tools — with a clear eye toward automation, support for configuration as code, and integration with our existing stack.
  • Enforcing procedures for safeguarding information security and safety within IT procedures.
  • Tracking hardware/software assets (licenses, warranties, accounts); identifying capacity and spending trends before they become problems.
  • Responding to internal and external audit requests in partnership with GRC and Security.
  • Operating and supporting the rollout of approved MCP integrations and AI workflows built by IT Engineering — owning the identity, access, deployment, and monitoring layers they depend on.
  • Recommending and implementing IT process improvements, with a bias toward automation over manual toil.

About you:

  • You have significant progressive IT experience, with meaningful time spent as a system administrator or engineer in a SaaS-first or distributed environment.
  • You thrive on solving problems through investigation and deductive reasoning, and you know when to escalate, when to dig in, and when to step back and redesign.
  • You invest in strong relationships with your colleagues and employ empathy when working through their technical issues. You can translate complex technical topics for non-technical audiences, and you can hold your own with security, engineering, and legal stakeholders.
  • You are self-driven, demonstrate initiative, and maintain a high degree of professional conduct at all times.
  • You are highly ethical, possess excellent decision-making capabilities, and execute good time management skills.
  • You question assumptions, drive change to mitigate potential risks, and possess excellent documentation skills.
  • You have deep working knowledge of corporate technologies — identity providers, MDM platforms, productivity suites, and endpoint security tooling — platforms such as Okta, Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune, Fleet, Google Workspace, Slack, and Zoom.
  • You are highly proficient with multiple versions of macOS, Linux, and Windows operating systems and have hands-on experience administering mobile device management platforms at scale (platforms such as Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune, or Fleet).
  • You have strong working knowledge of authentication and authorization protocols (SAML, OIDC, SCIM), MFA/SSO architectures, and common identity threats.
  • Experience in meeting goals in a fast-paced environment with rapidly evolving needs, including ownership of cross-functional projects from planning through delivery.
  • You have technical working knowledge and experience administering multiple SaaS applications at scale.
  • Experience managing infrastructure in AWS (compute, networking, IAM, backups, and monitoring) is a plus — while most of our stack is SaaS, IT Operations also hosts and manages self-hosted platforms in AWS.
  • Hands-on experience with GitOps practices for IT Operations — version control, pull request workflows, and Infrastructure-as-Code platforms such as Pulumi or Terraform — or demonstrated ability to get there quickly with prior scripting/automation experience.
  • Familiarity with enterprise AI platforms such as Claude Enterprise, and an understanding of how SSO, SCIM, MDM, and integration platforms combine to operate AI systems safely at scale.

Within 3 months, you'll…

  • Complete all HR and IT onboarding processes, familiarizing yourself with Posit's IT systems, security practices, and communication channels.
  • Familiarize yourself with Posit products, departments, and strategic goals.
  • Build working relationships with key stakeholders across IT Engineering, Security, GRC, and CloudOps.
  • Conduct a thorough review of existing IT documentation, tooling, and processes, and surface your first round of observations and recommendations.
  • Independently resolve complex end-user support escalations and begin taking over operational responsibility for at least one core IT system.
  • Review and contribute to existing GitOps codebases, starting with small, low-risk changes to get comfortable with the workflow.

Within 6 months, you'll…

  • Own end-to-end operations for at least one core IT platform, including its security posture, integrations, and roadmap.
  • Lead the design and rollout of at least one significant operational improvement — an automation, a new integration, a process simplification — with measurable impact.
  • Actively participate in, and help run, hardware logistics, onboarding, and offboarding workflows.
  • Mentor IT Engineers, pairing on tickets and reviewing their work.
  • Drive meaningful portions of your owned system(s) into Infrastructure-as-Code, making routine changes via pull request rather than console.
  • Act as a senior technical responder for enterprise AI platform and MCP-related incidents and escalations.

Within 12 months, you'll…

  • Be recognized across the organization as the go-to owner for your core platforms, consistently delivering on operational KPIs (uptime, MTTR, audit readiness, license utilization).
  • Have led at least one cross-functional IT project from planning through delivery, working with Security, GRC, and Engineering counterparts.
  • Have shaped IT's engineering standards and playbooks — authored or significantly contributed to key runbooks, ADRs, and shared code.
  • Play a lead role in audits and compliance activities for the systems you own, with clean findings and automated evidence where possible.
  • Be a trusted mentor for more junior team members and a visible champion of GitOps, documentation-as-code, and automation-over-toil inside IT.
  • Help plan and deliver the ongoing evolution of Posit's enterprise AI platform — platform readiness for new MCP integrations shipped by IT Engineering, governance improvements, and end-user enablement.

Posit offers competitive compensation with extensive human-first, people-focused benefits to prioritize your personal and financial well-being. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset. This hiring range reflects base salary and assumes that the job will be performed in the United States.

Hiring Range
$120,600—$159,170 USD

Working at Posit:

  • We welcome all talented colleagues and are committed to a culture that represents diversity in all its forms.
  • We prioritize giving ourselves “focus time” to get deep work done. We minimize meetings and attempt to operate asynchronously.
  • We are a learning organization and take mentorship and career growth seriously. We hope to learn from you and we anticipate that you will also deepen your skills, influence, and leadership as a result of working at Posit.
  • We operate under a unique sustainable business model: We have over 50% of our engineering dedicated to creating free and open source software. We are profitable and we plan to be around decades from now.
  • Posit is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a Certified B Corporation®, which means our open-source mission is codified into our charter. As a result, our corporate decisions balance the community's interests, customers, employees, and shareholders. Hear more about why we think this matters here.

Notable:

We offer competitive compensation with extensive human-first, people-focused benefits to prioritize your personal and financial well-being. These benefits apply to full-time positions only.

  • 100% of medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums are covered for employees and their families! Fertility and gender-affirming healthcare is included in all of our plans.
  • Supplemental mental health and wellness benefits are available via Ginger even if you don’t opt in to our insurance plans, including Ginger for teen family members.
  • Posit's gender-neutral paid parental leave policy covers all new parents, including foster and adoptive parents.
  • All full-time employees are eligible for 401k enrollment starting on day one.
    • After six months of employment, Posit provides a substantial yearly match to employee 401K contributions.
  • An annual profit-sharing bonus for employees recognizes our team’s contributions to company performance across the year.
  • We are a 100% distributed team. You are also welcome to come into our Boston office.
    • We offer a $400 monthly reimbursement for coworking space rental if you prefer to work away from home.
  • Our Lifestyle Savings Account offers an initial deposit of $1800 and then an additional quarterly stipend of $375 to cover the costs of professional development, wellness, financial health, charitable giving, and remote work support.
  • We provide a flexible environment with a generous vacation policy that encourages a minimum of four weeks PTO per year plus 15 paid company holidays.

Are you excited about this role but not sure if your experience aligns with every qualification in the job description? That’s okay. We know multiple perspectives are essential for a thriving organization and we'd still love to hear from you!

Posit is committed to being a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applicants of different backgrounds, cultures, genders, experiences, abilities, and perspectives to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, physical disability, or length of time spent unemployed.

Posit Software, PBC participates in the federal E-Verify program, which confirms employment authorization of newly hired U.S. based employees. E-Verify is not used as a tool to pre-screen candidates and is only initiated upon hire.

jobs.description:
Role:Senior Software Engineer – Core Banking (Symitar)

Why Westerra?

At Westerra Credit Union, we believe You Can Do Money. It is more than just a phrase. It is a mindset that shapes how we empower each other and our members to take control, grow, and thrive financially. Our culture is built on beliefs that guide how we show up every day. We focus on being member-obsessed, radically transparent, relentlessly collaborative, and always learning in motion. These are not just words. They are the heart of everything we do. Inspired by our vision to Out-Love Every Bank in Colorado, we bring genuine care and dedication to every member interaction. Our mission to teach, guide, and ignite members to own their financial future drives us to create meaningful, personal connections.

This mission comes alive through our MX Code, which encourages us to anticipate needs, listen deeply with both heart and head, find the best total solution, mark the moment, and truly own the impact we make. This is how we translate our strategy into experiences that matter. When you join Westerra, you become part of a vibrant community where innovation, openness, and collaboration are not just ideals; they are daily practices. Everyone is invited to bring their authentic selves, curiosity, and passion to the table. Together, we learn, grow, and thrive, committed to making a real difference for our members and one another. Because at Westerra, we do not just talk about money, we believe you can do money.

What is the role?

This role serves as the senior technical expert for Westerra's Symitar core banking platform. The Senior Software Engineer architects, develops, maintains, and optimizes Symitar solutions that support the credit union's core business operations. This individual designs and develops software programs, reports, integrations, automation, and custom solutions while ensuring the stability, security, and performance of the Symitar environment.

This role partners closely with business leaders, operations, digital banking, lending, accounting, and technology teams to improve business processes, automate manual work, resolve complex operational issues, and maximize the value of Westerra's investment in the Symitar platform.

What will be expected of me?

  • Serve as the technical expert for the Symitar core banking platform, including program development, processing support, and Symitar architecture.
  • Design, develop, test, implement, and support custom Symitar solutions that improve operational efficiency and member experience.
  • Partner with business owners to understand operational challenges and identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and enhanced system capabilities.
  • Analyze complex business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable Symitar solutions.
  • Develop and maintain programs, batch jobs, reports, letter files, custom screens, and automation processes.
  • Design and maintain integrations between Symitar and third-party systems using SymXchange, batch processing, APIs, and other integration technologies.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex production issues involving processing, performance, interfaces, and system functionality.
  • Lead technical troubleshooting efforts across multiple departments and vendors.
  • Ensure system changes are properly documented, tested, promoted, and supported throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Develop technical standards, coding practices, and documentation for Symitar development.
  • Recommend new capabilities, enhancements, and best practices that improve Westerra's use of the Symitar platform.
  • Participate in system upgrades, software releases, and vendor implementations.
  • Mentor junior developers and provide technical leadership across development initiatives.
  • Participate in DevOps processes including source control, testing, deployment, and change management.
  • Maintain appropriate security, compliance, and audit controls within all development activities.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Will I have direct reports? No

What am I bringing?

Experience/Education:

  • 8+ years of Symitar development experience supporting a financial institution.
  • Expert-level experience developing and supporting:
    • Symitar programming
    • LetterFiles
    • Batch processing
    • Job Files
    • Event-driven processing
    • Symitar Quest
    • SymXchange
    • Episys/Symitar database structure
  • Experience integrating Symitar with digital banking, payment systems, lending platforms, imaging, CRM, and other third-party applications.
  • Experience supporting Symitar software upgrades, releases, and system implementations.
  • Experience with SQL, scripting, APIs, web services, and file-based integrations preferred.
  • Experience with source control, software lifecycle management, testing, and deployment processes.
  • Experience working directly with Jack Henry support and third-party technology vendors.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Skills and Abilities:

  • Expert knowledge of Symitar architecture, data structures, processing, and development tools.
  • Strong understanding of core banking operations including deposits, loans, payments, member services, accounting, and operational processing.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex business problems and design scalable technical solutions.
  • Ability to identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and process redesign.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills across complex system interactions.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience gathering business requirements, estimating effort, designing solutions, and delivering projects.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high quality and attention to detail.
  • Strong documentation and technical writing skills.
  • Maintains a high level of confidentiality with member and organizational information.
  • Accountable for managing complex technical initiatives with minimal direction.
  • Routinely exercises independent judgment on significant technical and business issues.
  • Serves as a subject matter expert for Symitar development and architecture.
  • Influences technology direction by recommending best practices, architectural improvements, and long-term platform enhancements.
  • Builds collaborative relationships across departments and effectively partners with business leaders, vendors, and technology teams.

What is the work environment like, and are there physical requirements for this role?

  • Remote office environment
  • Works primarily at desk

Salary: In addition to the starting rate of $113,564 to $144,794, this role is also eligible for Westerra’s self-funding reward plan. This plan pays out a cash incentive annually if the company hits specific criteria tied to our financial goals and you will have a direct impact on the outcome of those results!

What are some of our benefit offerings?

  • Three health plans through UMR that offer a variety of coverage options, including HSA and FSA options
  • Two dental plans through Delta Dental
  • Basic life and AD&D insurance, short-term disability and long-term disability
  • 20+ days of paid time off (PTO) per year
  • 16 hours of volunteer time off (VTO) per year
  • 11+ paid holidays
  • 401(k) that includes up to 6% match
  • Up to $5250 per year for educational reimbursement
  • 2 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Mental health resources including an Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Home office reimbursement for hybrid/remote roles
  • Individualized learning and development programs

Please note, applications will be accepted until at least August 26, 2026.

Vous travaillerez en collaboration avec des équipes multidisciplinaires pour offrir des solutions techniques innovantes répondant aux besoins des utilisateurs et des clients.

Vos principales responsabilités incluront :

Toutes vos informations demeureront confidentielles en vertu des directives sur l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to support a cloud-based EGM management platform operating at large scale across complex infrastructure environments. The role focuses on platform engineering, automation, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and AWS infrastructure within a business-critical gaming technology environment.

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong experience with cloud infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code, deployment automation, and improving developer experience across distributed environments.

Responsibilities
• Standardise deployments into repeatable one button workflows across multiple environments
• Support developers by improving SDLC paths, environments, CI/CD pipelines, templates and local development tooling
• Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform on AWS
• Manage SDLC toolchains including GitHub, CI/CD, artifact registries, scanning tools and deployment orchestrators
• Work with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Harbor, Nexus, SonarQube, Trivy, ArgoCD and Helm where applicable
• Shape networking and service mesh patterns including VPCs, connectivity for air gapped systems and Istio
• Embed security from the beginning, including secrets management, RBAC, hardening and compliance automation
• Build useful observability focused on reliability, performance and business impact
• Partner with engineering teams to define release strategies such as Helm based deployments, ArgoCD, canary and blue green releases
• Support system design decisions, document trade offs and improve platform standards

Requirements

• Strong mid level DevOps experience, ideally 5–6 years
• Strong hands on experience with AWS and cloud infrastructure
• Practical experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code
• Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins
• Experience with Kubernetes, Helm and deployment automation
• Good understanding of Git discipline, versioned infrastructure and reviewed changes
• Strong scripting ability in Bash, Python, Makefiles or similar
• Experience supporting developers and improving SDLC processes
• Strong troubleshooting skills and ownership mindset
• Good English communication skills
Nice to have
• Experience with ArgoCD, GitOps and Helm based release models
• Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Fluentbit, OpenSearch or ADOT
• Experience with artifact registries such as Harbor or Nexus
• Experience with scanning tools such as SonarQube or Trivy
• Experience with Istio, API gateways, NGINX or HAProxy
• Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, Ignite, RabbitMQ or SQS
• Experience supporting JVM or TypeScript SDLC
• Experience with air gapped systems or restricted network environments
• Experience in gaming, regulated environments or high availability systems

Benefits

  • Solid, competitive salary
  • Work in multilingual, multinational and multicultural environment on international projects

jobs.description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking to hire for our Data side of our AI team at Speechify. This role is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support our model training operations. We are able to build high-quality datasets at petabyte-scale and low cost through a tight integration of infrastructure, engineering, and research work. We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join us.

What You’ll Do

  • Be scrappy to find new sources of audio data and bring it into our ingestion pipeline
  • Operate and extend the cloud infrastructure for our ingestion pipeline, currently running on GCP and managed with Terraform.
  • Collaborate closely with our Scientists to shift the cost/throughput/quality frontier, delivering richer data at bigger scale and lower cost to power our next-generation models.
  • Collaborate with others on the AI Team and Speechify Leadership to craft the AI Team’s dataset roadmap to power Speechify’s next-generation consumer and enterprise products.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field.
  • 5+ years of industry experience in software development.
  • Proficiency with bash/Python scripting in Linux environments
  • Proficiency in Docker and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts and professional experience with at least one major Cloud Provider (we use GCP)
  • Experience with web crawlers, large-scale data processing workflows is a plus
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

What we offer

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.
  • An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.
  • A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.
  • An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.
  • Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.
  • Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.
  • Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.
  • Work in one of the fastest-growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Refer them!

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. We are looking for Palantir Developers with strong commercial experience delivering solutions within Palantir environments.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

We are looking for Palantir Developers with strong commercial experience delivering solutions within Palantir environments. The role focuses on building, extending, and supporting enterprise-grade solutions on top of Palantir platforms in real production settings.

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring practical experience with platform implementation, integrations, workflows, and data-driven applications within complex enterprise environments.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain solutions within Palantir Foundry or related Palantir ecosystems
  • Develop and support data pipelines, workflows, integrations, and application logic
  • Work with APIs, backend services, and cloud-based platform components
  • Support automation, deployment, and operational use cases within Palantir environments
  • Collaborate with analysts, business teams, and stakeholders to deliver production-ready solutions
  • Contribute to system optimisation, scalability, and platform reliability
  • Participate in technical design, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities

Requirements

  • Minimum 3+ years of commercial experience working with Palantir platforms
  • Hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry or related Palantir technologies
  • Experience building or supporting enterprise-grade platform solutions
  • Strong understanding of integrations, workflows, and data-driven architectures
  • Practical experience with technologies such as Python, Java, SQL, APIs, or cloud tooling
  • Ability to work independently in delivery-focused environments
  • Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills
Nice to have:
  • Experience in large-scale enterprise transformation programmes
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure or data engineering environments
  • Experience working in Agile delivery models
  • Exposure to automation, deployment, or production support activities

Benefits

  • Solid, competitive salary
  • Work in multilingual, multinational and multicultural environment on international projects
  • Comprehensive healthcare
  • ​Long-term B2B contract with stable project pipeline

jobs.title: Senior Quantitative Analyst - Trading Risk & Fraud
jobs.excerpt: Zeal Group is an award-winning global FinTech powerhouse with 700+ professionals across London, Europe, Asia, MENA, and South America.
jobs.description:
Zeal Group is an award-winning global FinTech powerhouse with 700+ professionals across London, Europe, Asia, MENA, and South America. Through our subsidiary Traze, we deliver advanced multi-asset trading solutions across Gold, Oil, FX, Indices, and Cryptocurrencies, built for today’s fast-moving, high-volatility markets.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Quantitative Analyst to own the technical and analytical backbone of our trading risk and fraud function. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role — not a management position. You will design, build, and maintain the systems that detect toxic flow, latency arbitrage, and abusive trading behavior, and you will use that technology yourself to investigate, classify, and act on risk. You'll report to the Head of Risk, working with a high degree of autonomy and minimal oversight.

The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience and strong foundation with machine learning and data science in financial markets.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build the backend infrastructure, monitoring tools, and detection algorithms used to identify toxic flow, latency arbitrage, and abusive trading patterns.
  • Use the systems you build to investigate trading and non-trading activity, detect suspicious behavior, and report findings.
  • Analyze existing and new trading products and promotions for fraud/abuse exposure and propose mitigations.
  • Classify clients to support A-book/B-book decisioning and profitable execution outcomes.
  • Own end-to-end delivery: from raw data extraction and hypothesis testing through to production deployment of monitoring and alerting systems.
  • Continuously identify gaps in current processes and design new logic to increase automation and reduce manual intervention.
  • Mentor others on technical and analytical approaches as the function grows.

Requirements

Must have

  • 3+ years' experience in Quant/Trading OR FX/CFD brokerage environment, in a quantitative, risk, or analytics role.
  • Proficient experience with Python is mandatory.
  • Demonstrated experience independently building and owning production-grade tools, dashboards, or systems (not just using existing ones).
  • Can provide evidence of data science related projects, ideally end-to-end driven projects.
  • Strong knowledge of financial trading products, trading conditions, and execution mechanics.
  • Understanding of fraud/abuse patterns in trading (toxic flow, latency arbitrage, manipulation).
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Finance, or a related quantitative field.
  • Comfortable working with high ownership and low supervision; proactive and self-directed.

Preferred

  • Experience with SQL.
  • Experience or understanding of A/B-book risk models, transaction cost analysis, or execution analytics.
  • Exposure to regulatory reporting (MAR, FCA, CySEC, ASIC).
  • Track record of mentoring junior analysts.

This role suits someone who wants to build something from the ground up and use it, not just analyze data others have prepared. If you're a quant who thinks in systems, takes initiative without being asked, and wants ownership over a real risk function — this is built for you.
